text: {"lessons":["My account fell from its early high despite making almost no trades, reminding me that simply holding does not remove market risk; I should keep exposure aligned with a deliberate risk plan.","A few positive months or a brief recovery do not establish a reliable trend, so I should avoid extrapolating recent performance when deciding what to do next.","Since I check prices frequently and losses weigh heavily on me, I should use clear, portfolio-based decision rules rather than react emotionally to each monthly fluctuation."]}
